g.title: Recordings from any source. Real corpora are full of silence, hiss, clipping, test tones and phone-line audio.
shard-*.tar, manifest.jsonl and stats.json in the output directory. Only kept clips are stored. Rejection reasons are counted in the run totals and shown per clip by inspect and the live service.
The aerosieve binary. curate writes shards and prints rejection counts by reason. inspect prints one verdict per clip and writes nothing. --policy loads threshold overrides from JSON.

bindings/python (inspect and curate, built with maturin) and bindings/wasm (the browser demo). The WASM build decodes and scores once, then re-applies a policy to stored measurements on every slider move.
Serves /v1/stream, /metrics and /healthz. Each session holds a LiveInspector. Sessions, utterance length, frame size and idle time are capped, and a hand-written histogram tracks decision latency.
Decodes any container Symphonia can read, downmixes, resamples to 16 kHz and levels RMS toward -20 dBFS within 3 dB. It keeps the applied gain so full_scale() can recover the source's own peak.

A SpeechDetector scores each 32 ms window. EnergyDetector is the default and Silero via ONNX Runtime is a cargo feature. A state machine ends a clip after 500 ms of quiet, keeps 3 to 30 s, and cuts long runs at their deepest dip.
score returns WADA-SNR, RMS dBFS, clip ratio and spectral flatness, with no ML model. FilterPolicy::evaluate returns the first failing RejectReason, or none if the clip is kept.
Writes each kept clip as a .wav and .json pair in shard-*.tar, plus manifest.jsonl and stats.json. Shards are built in a staging directory and renamed into the output directory when complete.
